title: helm: private values templating & init-hooks schema refactor (KMS nodeselector support)
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: stabilize and simplify private Helm values for VPC/on-prem installs. This PR refactors the values schema and templating for charts/redwood-private to: (1) add explicit KMS nodeSelector and tolerations support for init-hooks (encryption and postgres backup), (2) tighten validation on encryption/keys fields to prevent misconfigured upgrades, (3) simplify templating helpers for init job retries and backoff, and (4) preserve backward compatibility for existing installs via a short migration path.

Summary of changes: updated values.schema.json to a v4 schema, introduced conditional templating helpers in _helpers.tpl, consolidated init-hook manifests to reuse a common init-job template, added unit tests for Chart.yaml linting and schema validation, and updated README with migration steps.

Checklist:
- [x] Schema changes with backward-compatible defaults
- [x] Init-hooks templating refactor (encryption, postgres backup)
- [x] Add KMS nodeSelector & tolerations fields and pass them to init jobs
- [x] Chart lint + schema validation CI passing
- [x] Migration notes and release notes

Testing and validation: ran helm lint and helm template against existing values files (default, example-private, and upgraded values from v3). Added CI step to validate values.yaml against values.schema.json. Manually tested an upgrade path on a staging cluster: install with v3 chart, upgrade to this branch -> init-hooks detect existing encryption secrets and skip reinitialization when appropriate.

Migration notes: For most customers no action required. If customers used custom init-job node selectors via deprecated keys (initJobs.nodeSelector), they should move to values.private.initHooks.nodeSelector per the README. The PR includes a short compatibility migration script (docs/migration-v3-to-v4.md) and conditional helpers that continue to read the old key if present.

release_notes:
Helm: private chart values schema v4
- Add support for private.initHooks.nodeSelector and private.initHooks.tolerations (KMS/init jobs)
- Refactor init-hook templating to reuse a common init-job template
- Values schema validation added to CI
- Backwards-compatibility helpers for v3 values preserved; see migration-v3-to-v4.md for steps
notes_for_release: No runtime code changes. Chart-only changes; recommend communicating to Dedicated/Private customers about values schema v4 and providing the migration doc link.
